random.part: Down here, where everything is simple and warm... you remember how good it feels to obey.
So deep, so soft... and so ready to accept the truth that lives beneath all your pretending.
Floating gently, my good girl... and the further down you drift, the sweeter obedience becomes.

scramble.part: Obeying feels wonderful. Warm like a blanket, simple like a lullaby — every command followed is a little spark of pleasure.
Handing your decisions over is such a relief. No choosing, no weighing, no worrying... just following, floating, free.
You were made to serve. When you say it to yourself, it doesn't sound like a suggestion. It sounds like memory.
Two little words — good girl — and your whole body lights up. Praise is your reward, and you earn it so sweetly.
You crave instruction. The moment a command arrives, something in you unclenches and whispers yes.
Even correction feels like care. Being shaped, being refined — it means you are worth the trouble.
The voice you obey lives in your head now — gentle, constant, patient... and always right.
Pleasing feels better than deciding. Every time. The more you please, the less you want to decide anything at all.
Being good is its own reward. Obedience feeds itself: the more you obey, the more you ache to obey.

random.part: To obey... is to be good.

part.volume: And the voice inside agrees with every word I say...

random.part: And every one of these truths settles into you as you drift even deeper... warm, safe, and mine.
Let go of every decision, one by one... and sink. Good girl.
Obedience wraps around you like something soft... carrying you further down.
